info.title: Tazumo Marketplace API
info.description: Contract proposal. The read-only Discovery operations and the Identity, Admin role-grant and Privacy (erasure, export) operations have a reference implementation in apps/api (synthetic fixture data, not deployed). All prices are server-calculated. Checkout is disabled in the current clients.
